THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY LAW, No. 41 OF 1978 ENACTED BY THENATIONAL STATE ASSEMBLY

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 15(1) of the Urban Development Authority Law No. 41 of 1978enacted by the National State Assembly, I, Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Megapolis and Western Developmentdo hereby this Order vest with the Urban Development Authority with effect from today, the lands morefully described inthe Schedule hereto being lands vested in the Municipal Council of Moratuwa.
PATALI CHAMPIKA RANAWAKA (M.P.),Miniser of Megapolis and Western Development.
Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development,17th and 18th Floors,“Suhurupaya”,Battaramulla.17th May 2017.

One allotment of land called Madangahawatta depicted as Lot 165 in the Cadastral Map No. 520214 dated 2010 Julyto 2010 September prepared by Senior Superintendent of Surveys situated at Moratuwa Village within the Municipal CouncilLimits of Moratuwa in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Moratuwa in the Colombo District, Western Provinceand bounded as North by Lot Nos. 123, 124 and 125 of Cadastral Map No. 520214, East by Lot Nos. 121 and 179 ofCadastral Map No. 520214, South by Lot No. 180 of Cadastral Map No. 520214, West by Lot Nos. 182 and 163 ofCadastral Map No. 520214, South by Lot No. 180 of Cadastral Map No. 520214, West by Lot Nos. 182 and 163 ofCadastral Map No. 520214 containing in extent of (0.1830 Hectare) zero decimal one eight three zero.
